title: Schedule of Credits and Courtesy Discounts by Call Class, Repair and Emergency Service Calls
content:
Three kinds of invoice relief on Repair and Emergency Service Calls are set per call class: the diagnostic credit on an approved repair, the courtesy discount program, and the on-time arrival credit. The schedule gives each class's settings.

## Diagnostic credit

| Call class | Diagnostic fee credited on a qualifying repair | Smallest repair subtotal, before discounts, that earns the credit | Calendar days after the diagnosing visit for a follow-up repair |
|---|---|---|---|
| Standard Service Call | Yes | $250.00 | 30 |
| Same-Day Priority Service Call | Yes | $250.00 | 30 |
| Evening Service Call | No | $250.00 | 0 |
| Weekend Service Call | No | $250.00 | 0 |
| Overnight Emergency Service Call | No | $250.00 | 0 |
| Holiday Emergency Service Call | No | $250.00 | 0 |

## Courtesy discount program (senior, military veteran and first responder)

| Call class | Courtesy program percentage | Courtesy program applies in this class |
|---|---|---|
| Standard Service Call | 10 percent | Yes |
| Same-Day Priority Service Call | 10 percent | Yes |
| Evening Service Call | 10 percent | Yes |
| Weekend Service Call | 10 percent | Yes |
| Overnight Emergency Service Call | 10 percent | No |
| Holiday Emergency Service Call | 10 percent | No |

## On-time arrival credit

| Call class | On-time credit | Late-arrival grace after the end of the window |
|---|---|---|
| Standard Service Call | $25.00 | 15 minutes |
| Same-Day Priority Service Call | $25.00 | 15 minutes |
| Evening Service Call | $25.00 | 15 minutes |
| Weekend Service Call | $25.00 | 15 minutes |
| Overnight Emergency Service Call | $0.00 (no on-time guarantee) | 15 minutes |
| Holiday Emergency Service Call | $0.00 (no on-time guarantee) | 15 minutes |

## Points of judgement

- An on-time credit of $0.00 means the class carries no on-time guarantee: the Overnight Emergency Service Call and the Holiday Emergency Service Call.
- The diagnostic credit is offered only in the Standard Service Call and Same-Day Priority Service Call classes; elsewhere the credit setting is No and the window is 0 days.
- The courtesy program percentage is 10 percent throughout, but the program applies only where the second column shows Yes.
